headline.fr: Le temps refroidit les espoirs de Brackenford

story.en: At 80 minutes, score 1-1, Brackenford’s win chance fell from 22% to 17% as time ran out and momentum stayed away. Substitutions helped, but the draw looks likeliest now.
story.es: Minuto 80, 1-1, la probabilidad de victoria de Brackenford bajó del 22% al 17% por el paso del tiempo y el impulso visitante. Los cambios ayudaron, pero el empate parece lo más probable.
story.pt: Aos 80 minutos, 1-1, a chance de vitória do Brackenford caiu de 22% para 17% com o tempo a perder e o ímpeto fora. As substituições ajudaram, mas o empate é o mais provável.
story.fr: À la 80e, 1-1, la probabilité de victoire de Brackenford est passée de 22% à 17% avec le temps qui filait et l’élan côté visiteur. Les remplacements ont aidé, mais le nul semble le plus probable.

analyst.en: Brackenford had 63% possession and Eastholme finished with higher xG, 0.74 to 0.46. The biggest driver of the points swing was time running out, shaving five points off Brackenford's win chance.

home.en: We have a man advantage, keep believing, press hard for a late winner.
home.es: Tenemos superioridad numérica, sigue creyendo, presionen fuerte por un gol tardío.
home.pt: Temos vantagem numérica, acredite, pressionem forte por um golo tardio.
home.fr: Nous avons un joueur en plus, gardez confiance, pressez pour un but tardif.

away.en: Clock is biting our chance, stay sharp, one push could still win it.
away.es: El reloj reduce nuestra oportunidad, mantente atento, un empujón todavía puede ganar.
away.pt: O relógio corta nossa chance, mantenha-se atento, um esforço ainda pode ganhar.
away.fr: Le temps grignote notre chance, restez concentrés, une poussée peut encore gagner.

story.en: Eastholme Rangers lead 2-1 after Adam Penke’s 82' goal, shifting win chance from 12% to 83%. Down to ten men but ahead late, they look set to hold on. Biscuits awarded.
story.es: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 tras el gol de Adam Penke al 82', la probabilidad de victoria pasa del 12% al 83%. Con diez, pero por delante tarde, parece que aguantan. Galletas gratis.
story.pt: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 após o golo de Adam Penke aos 82', a chance de vitória sobe de 12% para 83%. Com dez jogadores, mas na frente no fim, parecem seguros. Biscoitos grátis.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 après le but d’Adam Penke à la 82e, la probabilité de victoire passe de 12% à 83%. À dix mais en tête en fin de match, ils semblent bien partis. Biscuits offerts.

analyst.en: Eastholme's 82nd minute goal bumped their win probability from 12% to 83%, the biggest swing. Despite 63% possession for Brackenford and more passes, the goal and red card context drove the points change; xG remained modest at 0.51 for the scorer.

home.en: That late winner, hold your nerve. Defense, grit, finish. Keep believing.
home.es: Ese gol tardío, mantengan la calma. Defensa, coraje, finalizar. Sigan creyendo.
home.pt: Esse golo tardio, mantenham a calma. Defesa, coragem, finalização. Continuem a acreditar.
home.fr: Ce but tardif, gardez votre sang-froid. Défense, courage, finition. Continuez à y croire.

away.en: Heads up, you dominated the ball. Push until the last whistle, biscuits on me.
away.es: Ánimo, dominaron el balón. Empujen hasta el último minuto, galletas por mi cuenta.
away.pt: Força, dominaram a bola. Empurrem até ao apito final, bolachas por minha conta.
away.fr: Courage, vous avez dominé le ballon. Poussez jusqu'au dernier coup de sifflet, biscuits pour moi.

story.en: Eastholme Rangers hold 2-1 at 89', win chance up from 83% to 91% as the clock runs down, red card in their favor and little time for Brackenford to respond.
story.es: Eastholme Rangers mantienen 2-1 al 89', probabilidad de victoria sube de 83% a 91% mientras el tiempo se agota, roja a su favor y poco tiempo para que Brackenford reaccione.
story.pt: Eastholme Rangers seguram 2-1 aos 89', chance de vitória sobe de 83% para 91% com o tempo a acabar, cartão vermelho a seu favor e pouco tempo para a resposta do Brackenford.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers tiennent 2-1 à la 89e, probabilité de victoire passe de 83% à 91% avec le temps qui s'écoule, un rouge en leur faveur et peu de temps pour Brackenford.

analyst.en: Eastholme lead 2-1 at 89, xG impact driven by the 82' goal (0.51 xG) and Brackenford's possession edge. The biggest driver of the points change was the clock running down, adding eight points and lifting win probability from 83% to 91%.

home.en: Hold tight, favorites. Clock is on our side, see this home win through.
home.es: Aguanten, favoritos. El reloj está de nuestro lado, aseguren esta victoria en casa.
home.pt: Aguentem firme, favoritos. O relógio está do nosso lado, garantam esta vitória em casa.
home.fr: Tenez bon, favoris. L'horloge est de notre côté, assurez cette victoire à domicile.

away.en: Keep belief, fans. We pressed hard, one last push might still change things.
away.es: Mantengan la fe, aficionados. Presionamos mucho, un último empuje aún puede cambiarlo.
away.pt: Mantenham a fé, torcedores. Pressionamos muito, um último esforço ainda pode mudar tudo.
away.fr: Gardez la foi, supporters. Nous avons poussé fort, une dernière poussée peut encore tout changer.

headline.pt: Susto final confirma vitória do Eastholme

story.en: Eastholme Rangers beat Brackenford City 2-1, Adam Penke's 82nd minute goal held up. Win chance rose from 91% to 100% as the clock ran down and a red card killed the comeback.
story.es: Eastholme Rangers ganó 2-1 a Brackenford City, gol decisivo de Adam Penke al minuto 82. La probabilidad de victoria pasó de 91% a 100% mientras corría el tiempo y la roja frustró la remontada.
story.pt: Eastholme Rangers venceu Brackenford City por 2-1, Adam Penke marcou aos 82 minutos. A chance de vitória subiu de 91% para 100% com o relógio a correr e o vermelho a travar a reação.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers s'impose 2-1 contre Brackenford City, but décisif d'Adam Penke à la 82e. La probabilité de victoire est passée de 91% à 100% tandis que le temps s'écoulait et le rouge a ruiné la remontée.

analyst.en: Eastholme had 35% possession, 11 shots and xG 1.26; Brackenford 65% possession, 6 shots and xG 0.46. The biggest driver was the clock running down, adding nine points as time expired with a red card limiting a comeback.

home.en: Brilliant grind, favorites held on after a red card. Celebrate, but keep sharpening the edges.
home.es: Brillante esfuerzo, los favoritos resistieron tras la tarjeta roja. Celebren, pero sigan puliendo detalles.
home.pt: Trabalho brilhante, os favoritos aguentaram após o cartão vermelho. Comemorem, mas continuem a afinar.
home.fr: Beau combat, les favoris ont tenu après le carton rouge. Célébrez, mais continuez à peaufiner.

away.en: Tough night, we had more of the ball. Heads up, learn and come back stronger.
away.es: Noche dura, tuvimos más la pelota. Ánimo, aprendan y vuelvan más fuertes.
away.pt: Noite difícil, tivemos mais posse de bola. Cabeças erguidas, aprendam e voltem mais fortes.
away.fr: Soirée difficile, nous avons eu plus le ballon. Courage, apprenez et revenez plus forts.
